curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What happens when an extravagant cabaret troupe takes their unapologetic stage show deep into the remote desert heartland?
curatedMovie.description: In Stephan Elliott's comedy-drama, two drag performers and a transgender woman journey across the expansive Australian desert to stage their distinct cabaret act.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Funny, heartfelt, and easygoing, balancing vibrant theatrical energy with steady medium-paced drama.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Elliott pairs flamboyant showmanship with grounded human drama, delivering a warm, funny, and spirited cross-country road trip.

facts.title: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert
